correctness.rationale: The full graph-cut halfspace representation is proved by discrete coarea, with explicit Euclidean normal lengths and support constants. The complete-bipartite Laplacian's spectral gap makes all nonsingleton cut planes strictly farther than the singleton planes for \(N\ge8\). Exactly the singleton constraints of the larger part force its center coordinates to vanish and yield the cube bounds. The key inequality \(ap+(p-2a)b\ge p\sqrt{a+b}\) for integers \(p\ge4\) and \(1\le a<p/2\) follows from a nonnegative-coefficient or negative-discriminant argument; it proves all nonmiddle cut constraints redundant. For even p the only remaining inequalities correspond to \(a=p/2\), producing the exact square-root cap and sharp threshold \(N=p^2\). Endpoint equality, positive affine dimension, and cube-section vertex counts follow explicitly. The standard-library checker independently compared these center predicates with every cardinality-reduced graph cut for fifteen parameter pairs, plus checks of tight cut families and vertex counts. This is a proof for all stated integers, not an inference from finite tests.

originality.rationale: The 2021 primary paper studies graphical zonotope deformation cones, the 2022 complete-bipartite shuffle paper studies their combinatorial realization and face counts, and the prior published-finding corpus theorem determines the radius via a general cut quotient but expressly does not classify all Chebyshev centers. Full prior published-finding corpus RESULT.md and the relevant primary-paper material were inspected. The new contribution is the exact incenter-locus polytope, its odd/even structure, and the genuine phase threshold \(N=p^2\), none implied as an explicit classification by the statements checked. Historical priority remains provisional because older polytope-erosion literature is not exhaustively searchable.
residual_risks: Historical priority is provisional; a result may exist in older metric erosion, graph-zonotope, or optimization literature under a different name.
Two auxiliary indexed published records were compared from their abstracts/summaries rather than complete text, and those summaries cannot exclude undisclosed stronger coverage.

A generic all-cut halfspace formula is standard and provides an implicit center-set LP; novelty is the explicit all-parameter reduction and sharp phase transition, not the LP construction or the already-known radius.

value.rationale: Complete biclique graphical zonotopes are standard building blocks of generalized permutahedra and shuffle constructions. The center set of the largest inscribed ball is a canonical metric invariant not determined by the known face vector or radius. The theorem gives a natural complete classification, an odd/even dichotomy, a sharp order-squared phase transition in which new balanced-subset supporting inequalities genuinely become active, and exact vertex counts in the untruncated regime. This structure is meaningful independent of any downstream theorem and is not simply a finite numerical lookup.
